parsed.summary: The PR adds precomputed CDFs for several distributions, which should resolve the integration issues mentioned. The code is well-structured and follows the existing conventions.

issues.description: The new file `new_crv_types.py` has a different naming convention than the existing files in the `sympy.stats` directory. It would be better to follow the existing naming convention to maintain consistency.
The code could benefit from some additional comments to explain the logic behind the precomputed CDFs, especially for less common distributions.
